diffs.a1f3c9e:
--- a/app/orders/history.py
+++ b/app/orders/history.py
@@ -14,9 +14,14 @@ def order_history(user_id: str, limit: int = 50):
-    orders = db.query(Order).filter(Order.user_id == user_id) \
-        .options(selectinload(Order.items)).limit(limit).all()
-    return [serialize(o) for o in orders]
+    orders = db.query(Order).filter(Order.user_id == user_id).limit(limit).all()
+    result = []
+    for o in orders:
+        # fetch items so we can attach thumbnails
+        items = db.query(OrderItem).filter(OrderItem.order_id == o.id).all()
+        for it in items:
+            it.thumbnail = db.query(Product.thumb_url).filter(Product.id == it.product_id).scalar()
+        result.append(serialize(o, items))
+    return result
